verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents a guest-facing reschedule link that can be dropped into workflow messages. Its workflows also handle reschedules and cancellations, moving remaining steps to the new time or calling them off. That shows invitee rescheduling and cancellation exist, but the evidence does not show them working from the confirmation itself, enforcing policies, or syncing calendars. missing for 10: an explicit reschedule/cancel link on the booking confirmation, a documented invitee self-cancel flow, enforcement of reschedule/cancellation policies (notice windows, cutoffs), evidence that connected calendars update everywhere on change, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, invitees can reschedule or cancel from their confirmation, with my policies enforced and calendars updated everywhere

citations.quote: Drop in the guest's first name, the meeting time in their own time zone, a reschedule link, or their answers to your booking questions.
Reschedule, and the steps still to come move to the new time. Cancel, and they're called off.
